0022600136.text: The Toronto Raptors, 2-1 through three games and 1-0 at home, host the Orlando Magic in their fourth game of the season, sitting 2nd in the Atlantic at 0.5 games back and 4th in the East after a loss in their most recent game. Orlando is 1-2 overall and 0-2 at home, sits 4th in the Southeast and 10th in the East, and has not met Toronto yet this season, though the Raptors won the 2025-26 series 2-1 and beat the Magic 139-87 in their last meeting in Toronto. Toronto will be without Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), with Jalen Suggs listed as day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision.
